visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Two Pointers Instead of a List with contains
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An ArrayList and contains() are used to filter the duplicates of a sorted array, which scans the list for every element. Use a write index on the array itself. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Because the array is sorted, duplicates are neighbours, so comparing with the previous unique value is enough. contains() scans the whole list each time, which takes n squared steps and extra memory.
